title: TX queue: sample admission time while holding queue lock
description: Round-2 security review found get_now_ms() is sampled before acquiring queue->lock. A caller delayed on the mutex can have its absolute deadline pass yet still be admitted; if high priority, that stale packet can preempt valid traffic before later expiry. Default deadlines are likewise based on a stale pre-lock sample. Acquire the queue lock before sampling time, handle clock failure before queue mutation, compute relative defaults from the locked sample, and preserve expire-before-admission ordering.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit pushes delayed until their deadline are rejected without admission/preemption; default deadlines are based on the time sampled under the queue lock; clock failure occurs before mutation; deterministic race/seam tests and sanitizer-backed suite pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
